history.perspective: B20 - Notification scheduling correctness (DST, timezone, reboot, exact-alarm)
history.outcome: Reboot survival clean (library's own manifest). DST/timezone reasonably mitigated via foreground re-sync, one narrow industry-wide-hard residual edge case not worth chasing. Real finding: no SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM/USE_EXACT_ALARM declared, so reminders fall back to inexact delivery on Android 13+ (library degrades gracefully, no crash) - documented as a Play-Store-policy-sensitive product decision, deliberately NOT added unilaterally since it's a restricted permission requiring Play Console justification.
